note: Jackson Hole speech, 23 Aug, during trading hours. Exact words: 'The time has come for policy to adjust'; line paraphrases as rate cuts. Close +1.15% per price file.

note: Payrolls +142,000, unemployment 4.2%, released 8:30am ET. Close -1.73% vs prior close per price file. 'Weaker than hoped' reflects forecasts of 160,000 to 165,000 (search summaries; not opened).

note: FOMC statement 2:00pm ET on 18 Sep, inside trading hours; cut of 1/2 point to 4-3/4 to 5 percent. Close -0.29% per price file, no move claimed.
